$comment: Hand-edited source of truth. IA.md and matrix.csv are generated from this file by build.mjs; validate.mjs checks it. Derived from src/App.jsx + src/routes/*.jsx + src/pages/** + src/components/** + src/data/*.js first, then CLONE_SPEC.md and SPEC_PAGES_A/B/C.md for templates not yet built. Route counts for data-driven detail templates equal the number of entries in this clone's data files, not the live site's counts. The dev-only /__primitives showcase (src/pages/__Primitives.jsx) is dev tooling and is excluded from routes and templates.

meta.title: Kestrel marketing site: information architecture
meta.source: LORIKEET clone (React 18 + Vite + Tailwind v3) of a marketing site, placeholder content for the fictional product Kestrel; codebase at /Users/riyaghosh/V3/LORIKEET, specs CLONE_SPEC.md + SPEC_PAGES_A/B/C.md

categories.CHROME: Page-level frame around the template body: global nav, footer, floating video teaser, microsite header/footer, hidden assistant note.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block: headline, sub, actions and any hero art.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: logo tickers and walls, testimonial and story slideshows, employee quotes, pull quotes, stats.
categories.FEATURE: Product or company explanation modules: feature rows, bento panels, carousels of capabilities, value cards.
categories.CONTENT: The substantive body of a route: rich text, card lists and grids, FAQ blocks, documents.
categories.COMPARE: Kestrel-versus-category comparison tables and intro cards.
categories.FORM: Lead capture: demo, partner and nomination forms.
categories.NAVIGATION: In-page wayfinding: tables of contents, scroll-spy menus, share rails, filter/topic bars, doc sidebars.
categories.CTA: Calls to action that sit inside the body: callout rows, CTA cards, banners, sticky chips.
categories.MEDIA: Media-led blocks whose content is an illustration, photo set or video rather than text.
